name: clip5
description: Crafts clip: folding a sheet of green patterned origami paper on a white table (overhead), with finished origami pieces, a framed feather and a pine cone nearby. One Pexels clip, ElevenLabs narration placed at the moments the actions happen.

expected.referent: the sheet of green patterned origami paper
alternatives: the stack of patterned paper squares

lines.text: Fold it corner to corner, like this.

expected.referent: folding the square diagonally into a triangle and pressing it flat
alternatives: folding the paper in half into a triangle

lines.text: This is the first thing I ever learned.

expected.referent: (not visual: refers to the fold technique)

lines.text: Open it back out, so it looks like this.

expected.referent: the paper opened out flat as a square again, with a diagonal crease
along the folded edge of the paper triangle
the top point of the paper triangle
pinching the tip of the paper between the fingertips to fold it down
alternatives: folding the tip with both hands

expected.referent: the finished pink origami heart and star on the left of the table
alternatives: the folded paper heart and star
